nodes.name: Adult Outcomes as a Function of an Early Childhood Educational Program: An Abecedarian Project Follow-Up
nodes.description: A 2012 age-30 follow-up of the Abecedarian randomized trial, reporting educational, economic and social-adjustment outcomes. It is an ABC-only observed-outcome source, separate from pooled ABC/CARE life-cycle forecasts.
